evidence.reason: In terminateGracefully, signal the process group with SIGKILL once the leader closes within the SIGTERM grace window (and on the child.exited early return) so SIGTERM-ignoring same-group descendants cannot outlive child.close, without firing a sigkill rung marker so the narration stays 'sigterm' -> 'terminated'.
